title: Murmur: Efficient Long-Context ASR Inference with Hierarchical Chunking
abstract: arXiv:2606.01483v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-form automatic speech recognition (ASR) requires both high accuracy and low inference latency, but existing systems fall short of handling the trade-off between the two. Chunk-based approaches process audio in parallel windows for low latency, but lose cross-chunk context and need brittle heuristics to align speakers and timestamps at boundaries. Long-context ASR models transcribe everything in a single pass for better accuracy, but run several times slower, and a single repetition loop can corrupt the entire output. In this paper, we first analyze how context length affects the accuracy of long-context ASR models and find that an intermediate chunk size of about five minutes matches single-pass accuracy while avoiding repetition loops. translated_abstract: 长篇自动语音识别（ASR）既需要高准确率又需要低推理延迟，但现有系统难以在两者之间取得良好平衡。基于分块的方法通过并行窗口处理音频来获得低延迟，但会丢失跨块上下文，并且需要脆弱的启发式方法在边界处对齐说话人和时间戳。长上下文ASR模型通过单次处理转录全部内容以获得更好的准确率，但运行速度慢数倍，且单个重复循环就可能破坏整个输出。在本文中，我们首先分析了上下文长度如何影响长上下文ASR模型的准确率，发现约五分钟的中间块大小可以在避免重复循环的同时达到与单次处理相当的准确率。基于这一发现，我们提出了Murmur，一个基于分层分块的长篇ASR推理系统。长上下文模型并行解码中间目标块，并由一个快速的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了基于分层分块的长篇ASR推理系统Murmur，发现约五分钟的中间块大小可在避免重复循环的同时保持单次处理的准确率，并通过并行解码兼顾高准确率与低推理延迟。
en_tdlr: Murmur is a hierarchical chunking-based inference system for long-form ASR that achieves single-pass accuracy with low latency by decoding ~5-minute intermediate chunks in parallel while avoiding repetition loops.
